caption: The worked example with its own numbers: the build writes minSdkVersion 24 into the APK, and the tester's API 21 phone is 3 levels short, so install stops with INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK. compileSdk 34 only fixes the classes you compile against and targetSdk 34 only sets behaviour once the app runs; neither one decides who may install.

spec.title: minSdk 24 meets an API 21 phone
spec.aria: A downward flow from build.gradle with compileSdk 34, minSdk 24 and targetSdk 34, to the APK manifest holding minSdkVersion 24, to the tester's API 21 phone, to a shortfall of 3 API levels, ending in a refused install with INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK; the phone and the refusal are picked out.
